task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Overall coordination of the epidemic response: convene a central disaster bureau, set quarantine and travel-restriction policy across affected cities, allocate duties among other offices, and report daily situation to the throne.

Emergency fiscal response: release grain and treasury funds for relief, requisition and price-cap medical supplies and staple food, fund physicians and apothecaries, and forbid hoarding/profiteering in affected cities.

Public-works and sanitation measures: erect isolation wards and treatment camps at city outskirts, organize safe corpse burial teams and disposal pyres, secure clean water sources and clean streets, and commandeer workshops for medicine and protective gear.

Oversight and anti-corruption: dispatch inspectors to verify relief reaches the sick, audit grain and medicine distribution, impeach officials who conceal outbreak data or extort the dying, and ensure quarantines are enforced without abuse of the populace.
